text: あれ　わしは　どうしてたんじゃ？

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end asks for or gives an explanation; with a question word it means 'what on earth'. んじゃ is the old-man form of it. どうしてたんじゃ = 'what was I doing, I wonder?'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた says an action was going on in the past; してた is the shortened spoken form of していた. どうしてた = 'what was I doing'.
